adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: Ayo stands with T'Challa and the Dora Milaje as he welcomes the Avengers to Wakanda. She stays behind to guard Shuri while he leads the defense against Thanos's army.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Ayo's king. She guards Shuri while he leads Wakanda's defense.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: T'Challa's guard, who protects Shuri during the battle.
adds.evidence: Ayo is present with T'Challa and the Dora when the Avengers arrive in Birnin Zana, then stays behind to protect Shuri and fights Corvus Glaive in the lab (Avengers: Infinity War).

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: Aboard the Statesman, Loki stalls Thanos and tells him they have a Hulk, and the Hulk springs from hiding to attack Thanos.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Stalls Thanos so the Hulk can ambush him.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Attacks Thanos on Loki's cue aboard the Statesman.
adds.evidence: Loki's 'we have a Hulk' is the signal for the Hulk to spring from hiding and tackle Thanos on the Statesman.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: Bruce calls Steve to warn him that Thanos is coming for Vision, then rejoins him at the Avengers Compound. They fight side by side in Wakanda, where Bruce points Thanos out to him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An old friend Bruce calls for help, then fights beside in Wakanda.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An old friend who warns Steve about Thanos and fights beside him.
adds.evidence: Banner finds the phone Rogers left Stark and calls him about the threat to Vision, reunites with him at the Compound, fights in Wakanda and tells him 'Cap. That's him.'

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: Thor watches Thanos beat the Hulk aboard the Statesman before Heimdall sends the Hulk away. Bruce thinks his friend is gone until Thor arrives in Wakanda and saves the outnumbered Avengers.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Bruce thinks lost, who saves him in Wakanda.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend beaten by Thanos beside Thor, overjoyed to see him in Wakanda.
adds.evidence: On the Statesman Thor attacks Thanos after the Hulk is beaten; in Wakanda the Bifrost wipes out the Outriders mobbing Banner, Barnes, T'Challa and Rogers, and Banner is happy his friend survived.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: Bruce crash-lands on Earth and warns Tony about Thanos, pushing him to call Steve despite their split. Tony protects Bruce in New York when the Hulk refuses to come out.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Bruce warns about Thanos, who protects him in New York.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who warns Tony about Thanos and pushes him to call Steve.
adds.evidence: Banner reunites with Stark via Strange's portal, tells him about Thanos, convinces him to call Rogers, and Stark fights Cull Obsidian to protect him while the Hulk won't come out.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: When Vision offers to die to destroy the Mind Stone, Bruce argues he is more than the Stone and proposes removing it instead. He then fights in Wakanda to protect Vision.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Bruce refuses to let die for the Mind Stone.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Argues Vision is more than the Stone and fights to protect him.
adds.evidence: At the Avengers Compound Banner proposes removing the stone, saying Vision is more than it since he, Stark, Ultron and J.A.R.V.I.S. all contributed; he later fights Cull Obsidian and Glaive to defend Vision in Wakanda.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: Bucky and Sam stand watch together in Wakanda as Thanos's dropships crash into the city's dome, then fight in the battle that follows.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Stands watch with Bucky as Thanos's ships hit Wakanda's dome.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Stands watch with Sam as Thanos's ships hit Wakanda's dome.
adds.evidence: While the Avengers meet Shuri, Barnes and Falcon stand outside and watch the dropships crash into Wakanda's protective dome before the Battle of Wakanda.

adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: Steve and Bucky reunite with a hug in Wakanda and fight side by side against Thanos's army. After the Snap, Bucky calls out to Steve as he turns to dust.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Bucky's best friend, reunited in Wakanda. Bucky turns to dust calling his name.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Steve's best friend, who fades to dust calling his name.
adds.evidence: Barnes greets the Avengers in Wakanda and hugs Rogers ('How you been, Buck?'), fights in the Battle of Wakanda, and says 'Steve?' before disintegrating.
